verses.1: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD, my soul.
verses.2: While I live, I will praise the LORD. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.
verses.3: Don’t put your trust in princes, in a son of man in whom there is no help.
verses.4: His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth. In that very day, his thoughts perish.
verses.5: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD, his God,
verses.6: who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever;
verses.7: who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. The LORD frees the prisoners.
verses.8: The LORD opens the eyes of the blind. The LORD raises up those who are bowed down. The LORD loves the righteous.
verses.9: The LORD preserves the foreigners. He upholds the fatherless and widow, but he turns the way of the wicked upside down.
verses.10: The LORD will reign forever; your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise the LORD!
